_comment: Curated descriptions for DATA_DICTIONARY.md. Keys: tables.<table>, columns.<column> (any table) or columns.<table>.<column> (wins).

tables.contracts: One row per federal procurement contract award from COMPRANET (2002 to Sep 2025). Core fact table. Risk-score columns are statistical indicators, not findings.
tables.vendors: Suppliers as they appear in COMPRANET (one row per raw supplier id). Use vendor_canonical to merge duplicate ids. Individual (persona física) names are masked.
tables.vendor_canonical: Entity resolution for vendors: maps each raw vendor id to a canonical id (exact normalized-name / RFC-key matches only, Sep 2026).
tables.vendor_canonical_map: Earlier (pre-Sep 2026) vendor canonicalization map. Superseded by vendor_canonical; kept for reproducibility.
tables.vendor_match_candidates: Candidate duplicate-vendor pairs from entity resolution, PUBLIC tiers only (link-only suggestions, not merges).
tables.vendor_rfc_quality: Per-vendor grade of the tax-ID (RFC) evidence. The RFC values themselves are removed; grades, sources and flags remain. RFC-derived dates are NULL for individuals.
tables.vendor_aliases: Legacy fuzzy name-similarity groups (measured precision ~19% on an RFC gold set). Retired from the platform UI; do not treat a shared group as the same company.
tables.vendor_groups: Legacy fuzzy vendor groups built from vendor_aliases. Same caveat as vendor_aliases.
tables.vendor_name_variants: Spelling variants of vendor names observed in the source data.
tables.vendor_stats: Precomputed per-vendor aggregates over contracts (counts, value, rates, average v0.8.5 risk indicator).
tables.vendor_scorecards: Composite vendor grade derived from risk indicators and conduct pillars (platform scorecard).
tables.vendor_graph_features: Co-award network features per vendor (PageRank, centrality, community).
tables.vendor_institution_tenure: First/last year and volume of each vendor-institution relationship.
tables.vendor_investigation_features: Per-vendor feature values and anomaly scores used for investigation triage.
tables.vendor_rolling_stats: Vendor rolling (as-of-year) aggregates used to build model features.
tables.vendor_shap_v52: Per-vendor SHAP explanation of an earlier model (v5.2). Historical; the active score is risk_score_v8.
tables.institutions: Buying institutions (federal agencies, state-owned firms, some state/municipal bodies) as they appear in COMPRANET.
tables.institution_canonical: Entity resolution for institutions: raw institution id to canonical id (4,415 raw to ~3,462 canonical), with government level and INEGI codes where known.
tables.institution_successor: Institution renamings / successions (old id to successor id, effective date, legal source).
tables.institution_scorecards_pre_reform: Institution scorecards before the 2026 scorecard reform. Historical.
tables.institution_top_vendors: Top vendors per institution by contract count/value.
tables.institution_hhi: Herfindahl-Hirschman vendor concentration index per institution and year.
tables.institution_vendor_concentration: Each vendor's share of an institution's contract value.
tables.institution_z_means: Mean standardized model features per institution.
tables.ramos: Federal budget branches (ramos) and their sector.
tables.categories: Spending categories (auto-classified from CUCoP/partida codes and keywords).
tables.category_vendor_institution_topn: Top vendor x institution pairs per category.
tables.cucop_generica_map: Mapping of CUCoP 'genérica' spending codes to categories.
tables.contract_types: Contract type lookup (adquisiciones, obra pública, servicios, ...).
tables.procedure_types: Procurement procedure lookup (licitación pública, invitación, adjudicación directa, ...).
tables.size_tiers: Vendor size tiers by contract count.
tables.laassp_thresholds: Legal value thresholds for procedure types under LAASSP, by year.
tables.exchange_rates: MXN/USD FIX and price indices by month (for currency/real-value conversion).
tables.gap_contracts: Post-COMPRANET (2025) awards recovered from the ComprasMX portal and its award documents (OCR). Separate from contracts and never mixed into contract totals. Amounts are partly pre-award estimates or OCR-recovered.
tables.ground_truth_cases: Labelled corruption-pattern cases used to train/evaluate the risk model. Provenance in provenance_tier (A/B/C) and case_origin: most are model_discovery (analyst write-ups of model-flagged vendors), not independently documented. Not a list of proven corruption.
tables.ground_truth_vendors: Vendor links of ground_truth_cases, with evidence strength, match method and false-positive review flags (is_false_positive / fp_*).
tables.ground_truth_sources: External sources (press, audit, legal) attached to ground_truth_cases.
tables.hard_negatives: Contracts used as hard negatives in model training.
tables.procurement_scandals: Curated catalogue of documented, publicly reported Mexican procurement scandals with sources. Only entries re-verified on 2026-10-03 (is_verified=1) are published.
tables.investigation_cases: Auto-generated investigation case files. Published only when validation_status='corroborated' (0 rows in this release; schema kept). Machine-generated leads, not findings.
tables.case_vendors: Vendors attached to published investigation_cases (follows the investigation_cases gate).
tables.case_questions: Open questions for published investigation_cases (follows the investigation_cases gate).
tables.aria_queue: ARIA investigation-priority queue: one row per vendor with a priority score (ips_final), tier (1 = highest) and a pattern label. Triage ordering, not an accusation. Generated memo text removed.
tables.ghost_confidence_scores: Signals consistent with shell/ghost suppliers per vendor (registry flags, short life, bursts). Signals, not determinations.
tables.capture_results: Institution-vendor 'capture' trajectories (a vendor's share of an institution's spend over time).
tables.co_bidding_stats: Vendor pairs appearing in the same procedures. Measures co-awards, not proven co-bidding or collusion.
tables.corporate_groups: Corporate groups with a recorded verification source (unverified auto-generated groups excluded).
tables.company_registry: Per-vendor registry checks derived from the RFC (validity, entity type, incorporation year) and SAT EFOS / SFP flags. RFC values removed; incorporation dates NULL for individuals.
tables.sat_efos_vendors: SAT EFOS list (taxpayers presumed to invoice simulated operations, Art. 69-B CFF), as published by SAT.
tables.sfp_sanctions: Supplier sanctions (inhabilitaciones/multas) from the SFP registry, as published; sanctioned public servants excluded.
tables.rupc_vendors: Registro Único de Proveedores y Contratistas (RUPC) extract.
tables.asf_cases: Findings from Auditoría Superior de la Federación (ASF) audit reports. Amounts are audited totals, not losses.
tables.asf_institution_findings: ASF findings aggregated per institution and audit year.
tables.asf_ramo_crosswalk: Crosswalk ASF institution name to ramo.
tables.asf_institution_crosswalk: Crosswalk ASF case to RUBLI institution id (exact/curated matches with basis and confidence).
tables.price_hypotheses: Machine-generated price-anomaly hypotheses per contract. Unreviewed unless is_reviewed=1.
tables.contract_ml_anomalies: Isolation-forest / IQR anomaly flags per contract.
tables.contract_partida_features: Partida (budget line) features per contract (2023+ data).
tables.contract_z_features: Standardized (z-score) model features per contract (v6-era feature set).
tables.contract_z_features_v2: Additional standardized features used by the v0.8.5 model.
tables.risk_scores: Legacy per-contract risk score table. The active indicator is contracts.risk_score_v8.
tables.factor_baselines: Per sector x year baselines (mean/stddev) for model features.
tables.partida_baselines: Log-amount and rate baselines per partida.
tables.sector_price_baselines: Contract value percentiles per sector x contract type x year.
tables.feature_importance: Model feature importance / coefficients by model version.
tables.model_calibration: Model calibration records (coefficients, intercept, PU correction, metrics) by version. v0.8.5 is sector_id = 0.
tables.drift_report: Feature drift report by year and sector.
tables.precomputed_stats: Platform precomputed statistics (JSON blobs keyed by stat_key).
tables.subnational_state_stats: Per state x year aggregates (state-level buyers in COMPRANET).
tables.yearly_vendor_rankings: Vendor ranks by value/count per year.
tables.yearly_institution_rankings: Institution ranks by value/count per year.
tables.atlas_cohort_period_stats: Platform Atlas view precompute (cohort x period).

columns.vendor_id: Raw vendor id (vendors.id). Merge with vendor_canonical.canonical_id for entity-level analysis.
columns.institution_id: Raw institution id (institutions.id). Merge with institution_canonical.canonical_id.
columns.canonical_id: Canonical entity id after entity resolution.
columns.match_basis: Evidence used for the match (e.g. exact normalized name, RFC key, curated).
columns.vendor_name: Vendor display name (individuals masked as PERSONA FISICA <vendor_id>).
columns.total_value_mxn: Sum of contract amounts, nominal MXN.
columns.avg_risk_score: Mean risk indicator (0-1) over the contracts; statistical similarity to labelled cases, not a probability of corruption.
columns.direct_award_pct: Share of contracts awarded by direct award (%).
columns.single_bid_pct: Share of competitive procedures with a single bidder (%).
columns.high_risk_pct: Share of contracts with risk indicator >= 0.40 (%).
columns.created_at: Row creation timestamp in the internal database.
columns.updated_at: Row update timestamp in the internal database.
columns.contracts.source_structure: COMPRANET file structure era: A 2002-2010, B 2010-2017, C 2018-2022, D 2023-2025.
columns.contracts.source_year: Year of the source file the row came from (may differ from contract_year).
columns.contracts.procedure_number: Procurement procedure number (several contracts can share one).
columns.contracts.title: Contract title as published (individual names inside masked). 2003-2010 titles carry encoding damage (accented letters replaced by 'ý' at source).
columns.contracts.amount_mxn: Contract amount in MXN (converted from original currency). Values > 100B MXN are rejected as data errors (set to 0); > 10B MXN are flagged.
columns.contracts.contract_year: Contract year (= year of contract_date; 175,777 Structure-B rows re-yeared from 2010 to 2011/2012 in Sep 2026).
columns.contracts.is_single_bid: 1 = competitive procedure (not direct award) with only one vendor.
columns.contracts.risk_score: Legacy risk indicator column (earlier model). Prefer risk_score_v8.
columns.contracts.risk_level: Risk band of the active v0.8.5 indicator: critical >= 0.60, high >= 0.40, medium >= 0.25, low < 0.25.
columns.contracts.risk_factors: JSON list of risk factors triggered (legacy).
columns.contracts.risk_score_v8: ACTIVE risk indicator (model v0.8.5, ElasticNet logistic + PU correction). Similarity to labelled cases; NOT a probability of corruption. Forward-holdout AUC 0.656.
columns.contracts.risk_score_v5: Historical v5.1 score (known temporal leakage). Do not use for evaluation.
columns.contracts.is_gold_holdout: 1 = contract reserved for model holdout evaluation.
columns.contracts.publication_delay_days: Days between contract date and publication (negative / extreme values are data-quality issues).
columns.contracts.category_source: How category_id was assigned (CUCoP code, partida, keyword).
columns.vendors.name: Supplier name as published (individuals masked).
columns.vendors.is_individual: 1 = flagged persona física by name heuristics in the internal pipeline (noisy: also flags some public bodies and companies).
columns.vendors.size_stratification: Vendor size as declared in COMPRANET (micro/pequeña/mediana/grande).
columns.vendors.legal_suffix: Legal-entity suffix parsed from the name (S.A. de C.V., S.C., ...).
columns.vendors.first_token: First token of the normalized name (masked for individuals).
columns.vendors.phonetic_code: Phonetic key of the name (masked for individuals).
columns.vendors.phonetic_tokens: Phonetic tokens of the name (masked for individuals).
columns.vendors.avg_risk_score: Legacy denormalized mean risk. Prefer vendor_stats.avg_risk_score.
columns.institution_canonical.level: Government level of the canonical body.
columns.institution_canonical.canonical_key: Normalized key used to group raw institution ids.
columns.institution_successor.source_url: Legal source (e.g. DOF decree) for the succession.
columns.vendor_canonical.group_size: Number of raw vendor ids in the canonical group.
columns.vendor_match_candidates.tier: Candidate tier (PROBABLE_* / REVIEW_*). Only public tiers are exported.
columns.vendor_match_candidates.cosignals: Supporting signals (shared institutions, years, RFC root) for the candidate pair.
columns.vendor_match_candidates.public: 1 = tier cleared for public display (all exported rows).
columns.gap_contracts.source_structure: Source tag for the ComprasMX recovery.
columns.gap_contracts.amount_mxn_estimated: Pre-award estimated amount published with the procedure (not the contract value).
columns.gap_contracts.amount_is_estimated: 1 = the best amount is a pre-award estimate.
columns.gap_contracts.amount_mxn_recovered: Award amount recovered by OCR/parsing of the award document (fallo/contrato).
columns.gap_contracts.amount_mxn_best: Best available amount (recovered award amount, else estimate). Mixed currencies were not all converted; check currency.
columns.gap_contracts.amount_review_flag: 1 = amount needs review (OCR outlier or > 10B MXN).
columns.gap_contracts.vendor: Awarded vendor name from the award document (individuals masked; NULL where the portal withheld it).
columns.gap_contracts.gap_risk_score: Simple rule-based flag score for gap data (NOT the v0.8.5 model).
columns.gap_contracts.efos_flag: 1 = vendor matched the SAT EFOS list.
columns.ground_truth_cases.case_origin: Provenance: model_discovery (flagged by the model/ARIA then written up), media_report, official_record, audit, ...
columns.ground_truth_cases.confidence_level: Analyst confidence label (low / medium / high / confirmed_corrupt). Not a legal determination.
columns.ground_truth_cases.estimated_fraud_mxn: Analyst estimate. For most model_discovery cases this approximates the vendor's total contract value, not an estimate of diverted funds.
columns.ground_truth_vendors.is_false_positive: 1 = link reviewed and judged a false positive. Exclude from labels.
columns.ground_truth_vendors.curriculum_weight: Training weight from confidence (confirmed 1.0 / high 0.8 / medium 0.5 / low 0.2).
columns.aria_queue.primary_pattern: Pattern label (P1-P7) the vendor most resembles. A signal for triage, not a finding.
columns.aria_queue.in_ground_truth: 1 = vendor linked to a ground_truth case (all Tier-1 vendors are).
columns.company_registry.rfc_entity_type: fisica (individual) / moral (company), from the RFC shape.
columns.company_registry.rfc_inc_year: Incorporation year from the RFC date block (NULL for individuals: it is a birth date).
columns.company_registry.rfc_age_years: Age of the RFC registration in years (NULL for individuals).
columns.vendor_rfc_quality.rfc_date: Date block of the best RFC (NULL for individuals: it is a birth date).
columns.model_calibration.sector_id: 0 = global model (v0.8.5 convention); older versions used NULL.
columns.ground_truth_cases.provenance_tier: Evidence provenance tier (Oct 2026, strict rubric): A = official record (court/FGR/DOJ action, dated SFP/SAT/COFECE resolution, specific ASF finding, or registry hit by RFC/exact name on a linked vendor); B = credible press with named outlet and date/URL; C = model discovery, ARIA/COMPRANET self-citation, analyst write-up or generic citation. Only A/B are independently sourced.
columns.ground_truth_cases.evidence_summary: Machine-assembled provenance note: tier, origin, and source headlines/links found (private individuals' names masked).
